name: OR oracle
description: Implement a quantum oracle on $$$N$$$ qubits which implements the following function: $$$$$$f(\vec{x}) = x_0 \vee x_1 \vee \dotsb \vee x_{N-1}$$$$$$ You have to implement an operation which takes the following inputs: an array of $$$N$$$ ($$$1 \le N \le 8$$$) qubits $$$x$$$ in an arbitrary state (input register), a qubit $$$y$$$ in an arbitrary state (output qubit), and performs a transformation $$$|x\rangle|y\rangle \rightarrow |x\rangle|y \oplus f(x)\rangle$$$. The operation doesn't have an output; its "output" is the state in which it leaves the qubits. Your code should have the following signature: namespace Solution { open Microsoft.Quantum.Primitive; open Microsoft.Quantum.Canon; operation Solve (x : Qubit[], y : Qubit) : Unit { body (...) { // your code here } adjoint auto; } }
